story: Exiled from the Metaverse before it even started: Facebook bans are for life
text: My rant was more about the Metaverse as proposed and controlled by Meta. Funny, after I wrote this I watched a Eric Meijer video and he talked about the 10th man, a concept new to me. I was being the 10th man for a moment. In a group of 10, one is designated as the 10th man (or person, but I'll go with Erik's term.) When 9 people agree, the 10th man is required to disagree. This throws a monkey wrench into groupthink. 2016 - One Hacker Way Rational alternative of Agile - Erik Meijer (at minute 25:00 in case the time param doesn't work) [VIDEO] Edit: He's now Director Of Engineering at Meta so maybe he can be the 10th man at Meta [LINK]

story: I had to give a wrong answer to get the job (2017)
text: In the Benelux, try to get a job after answering what you really think about Scrum. If the local Scrum Master is present in the interview team you will be "persona non grata" for the rest of your career... "One Hacker Way Rational alternative of Agile - Erik Meijer" [VIDEO] Nowadays a Developer has to act a little bit like in this scene from Good Will Hunting. Make yourself stupid...you will be hired. [LINK]
